title: Cang Yutian's Invitation
next_chapter_hook: Just as Cang Yutian was about to reveal the weakness of the Heavenly Dao Eye, a cold will suddenly emanated from the depths of the Void—a gaze from a higher dimension, signifying that Chen Ji's whereabouts had been perceived by this existence that transcended all.

text.content: The patterns on the inner wall of the turtle shell suddenly burned hot against Chen Ji's palm, as if sensing some resonance with the axis of destiny. He stared intently at the blurry premonitory vision—Cang Yutian's silhouette flickering in and out within that twisted temporal chaos, yet never revealing a clear face. This eerie sense of 'obscuration' sent a chill through his heart. An ordinary eye-covering technique could never achieve this degree of concealment, unless the opponent's power had already touched the boundaries of the realm that the Tianji Record could reach. Covering... not rewriting the marks on the axis of destiny, but using another chain of cause and effect to 'mask' the original trajectory. This thought struck his mind like lightning, piercing through the fog, but the subsequent question was—the power required for 'covering' was by no means something his current cultivation could bear.

Just as he was racking his brains, the Void tore open without warning. A figure stepped leisurely out from the chaotic rift capable of devouring all things, surrounded by pale golden mist, each step like placing a new piece on the board of predetermined fate. That was not a display of cultivation pressure, but something far more fundamental—as if this person himself was the very incarnation of the two characters 'cause and effect.' Cang Yutian had finally appeared. He looked merely thirty years old, his features elegant yet bearing an indescribable vicissitudes, his deep eyes swirling with endless cycles of cosmic destruction and rebirth.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Cang Yutian's voice rang like an ancient bell, carrying an antiquity that spanned millennia, "The holder of the Tianji Record is actually trying to escape the predetermined trajectory of fate through 'covering' rather than 'rewriting'—this line of thinking is rather impressive." He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze falling upon the turtle shell in Chen Ji's hand, the corner of his lips slightly lifting, "Unfortunately, at your current realm, even covering requires a price beyond imagination."

text.content: Chen Ji下意识后退半步，却发现四周的空间早已被无形的力量锁死。他强迫自己冷静下来，与这个传说中的终极棋手对视。仓御天的气息深不可测，每一次呼吸都像在与天地法则本身进行某种隐秘的交流。这种存在，远比他之前遇到的任何敌人都要危险——包括那个所谓的凌渊老者。在仓御天面前，他感觉自己仿佛被放置在棋盘正中，每一步可能的移动都被提前计算完毕。

dialogue.content: "So what?" Chen Ji's voice was unexpectedly calm, even carrying a hint of mockery, "The ultimate chess player personally intervenes, just to appreciate a ant's desperate struggle? Or could it be—" he deliberately paused, his gaze fixed on Cang Yutian's eyes that seemed to contain the universe, "the grand scheme the elder has been orchestrating for ten thousand years has finally reached the harvest season?"

text.content: Cang Yutian upon hearing this did not become angry; instead, he chuckled lightly: "Harvest?" He shook his head, his smile carrying a complex meaning, "If this one merely wished to harvest the fragments of the Tianji Record, why wait until today? The secrets the stubborn old fools of the Tianqing Sect have guarded for a thousand years—if this one wanted them, it would be as easy as taking something from one's own pocket." His words were plain, yet carried absolute confidence—a supreme arrogance that regarded all chess players under heaven as playthings, "Chen Ji, this one came today to discuss a transaction with you."

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian appeared in the guise of the ultimate chess player, directly stating he wishes to discuss a transaction with you. Facing what may be the greatest opportunity and deepest trap of your life, you choose—

choices.description: Since the opponent has voluntarily revealed themselves, why not hear the true intentions of this ultimate chess player—at the very least, seek flaws within the dialogue.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the truth about the Heavenly Dao Eye
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's rhetoric is unfathomably deep, making it easy to be manipulated in reverse

dialogue.content: "Very well." Seeing Chen Ji did not immediately refuse, a hint of appreciation flickered in Cang Yutian's eyes, "A person worthy of causing this one to appear in person—you are at least a hundred times better than those idiots who jump at the mere mention of 'transaction.'" He waved his hand, and the surrounding space transformed; the two had somehow arrived within a vast sea of stars, "Since you have the courage to listen, this one shall tell you some... secrets that should never be known by anyone."

choices.memory_label: 仓御天首次以平等姿态对话

choices.description: The ultimate chess player's transaction surely conceals deadly traps; first feign weakness to stall, never reveal your trump cards.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the initiative that ensures invincibility
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may lose patience as a result

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's brow slightly raised, seemingly quite surprised by Chen Ji's refusal: "Oh? This one personally invites you, yet you dare refuse?" His tone remained placid, but the surrounding sea of stars suddenly dimmed by three degrees, the roaring sound of spinning stars like the funeral bell of doomsday, "Interesting—however Chen Ji, this one advises you to think carefully before answering. The consequences of opposing this one are not something a mere Foundation Building stage disciple can bear."

choices.memory_label: 仓御天首次展现出不满

choices.description: Do not respond directly; instead, throw out a probe—why did Cang Yutian personally appear? Does he also have weaknesses?
choices.visible_reward: May obtain crucial information about Cang Yutian's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's schemes run extremely deep, and the risk of being counter-probed is extremely high.

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter toward the sky. That laughter echoed through the star sea, causing countless stars to tremble: "Good! Good! Good!" He said three "goods" in a row, his eyes even showing genuine appreciation, "For ten thousand years, this seat has finally encountered someone who dares to take the initiative against this seat." His gaze turned sharp, "Speak, what do you want to know? This seat is in a good mood today, perhaps I can answer you one or two questions."

choices.memory_label: 仓御天被陈机的胆识打动

text.content: In the depths of the star sea, Cang Yutian walked slowly, and Chen Ji discovered he could actually keep up with the other's pace—not because he had become faster, but because Cang Yutian had deliberately slowed down the flow of time. "This seat has been scheming for ten thousand years, not for dominating the three realms." Cang Yutian's voice echoed through the star sea, each word like a falling star, "But to find an... heir who can replace the Eye of Heavenly Dao." These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. Replace the Eye of Heavenly Dao? What did this mean?

dialogue.content: "You should have already sensed it." Cang Yutian stopped and turned to face Chen Ji directly, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not invincible. Its essence is a collection of wills born from a genius cultivator from countless years ago, who burned himself as fuel. This seat's predecessor was the one closest to it in that era." He pointed to his own chest, "Unfortunately, that battle, this seat lost. Lost completely, only able to survive until now with a fragmented soul."

text.content: Chen Ji felt waves of shock crashing in his heart. Cang Yutian was actually the first holder of the Tianji Record? That ancient great power defeated by the Eye of Heavenly Dao? He tightly suppressed the turmoil within, yet on the surface maintained a calm facade: "So what you're suggesting is that you want me to finish your unfinished business?" Cang Yutian shook his head, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Not for this seat. Rather—you are the one chosen by the Tianji Record. This seat merely... appeared at the right time, in the right place."

dialogue.content: "Chosen?" Chen Ji coldly smiled, "Your words are too casual. The Tianji Record chose me simply because it's incomplete and needs a host to survive. In the end, I'm just one of the pieces you've set in motion, correct?" His tone carried undisguised sarcasm. Cang Yutian hearing this showed no anger, his eyes even revealing a trace of gratification: "You're indeed sharp. Indeed, you are a piece—but what this seat wants to tell you is that often, there's only one step between a piece and a chess player."

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian revealed shocking truth: he was actually the first master of the Tianji Record, the former challenger of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. This massive information requires digestion—

choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao can be defeated, there must certainly be weaknesses. Since Cang Yutian appeared voluntarily, he should be willing to reveal some key information.
choices.visible_cost: May expose one's own trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues about the Eye of Heavenly Dao's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may use this as leverage

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao's weaknesses?" Cang Yutian pondered for a moment, "Its power comes from the gathering of sentient belief—if every living creature believes fate cannot be defied, it grows stronger. And its weakness lies precisely in this." He looked at Chen Ji, "If someone could make enough living creatures believe—that fate can be rewritten, then its power would begin to collapse. Of course, this requires an opportunity... a major event shocking enough to affect all worlds."

choices.memory_label: 获得天道之眼弱点的关键信息

choices.description: Cang Yutian's words are too beautiful, beautiful enough to be a trap. Why would a defeated one from ten thousand years ago understand the Eye of Heavenly Dao so well? How much of what he says is credible?
choices.visible_reward: Force Cang Yutian to reveal more truth
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may terminate the dialogue as a result

dialogue.content: "Easy for you to say." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, "A defeated one from ten thousand years ago, yet knows the Eye of Heavenly Dao's weaknesses inside out? If that were true, why did you lose back then? Why hide for ten thousand years before appearing?" A mocking smile curled at the corner of his mouth, "In my view, your words are nothing but attempts to use me. As for the so-called 'weaknesses'—who's to say it's not bait for another trap?" Cang Yutian remained silent for a long while, then suddenly sighed: "Your vigilance brings this seat comfort. But some things must be verified by you personally..."

choices.memory_label: 仓御天对陈机的质疑表示理解

text.content: At this moment, a sudden disturbance came from the depths of the star sea. Cang Yutian's brow furrowed slightly, and he looked up toward the depths of the void: "It has noticed us here." Chen Ji followed his gaze but saw nothing. Yet he could feel an invisible pressure rushing in from all directions—some existence beyond comprehension was turning its attention here. Cang Yutian gently waved his sleeve, dispersing that pressure: "No need to worry. Since this seat dares to appear here, there are preparations. However—" He looked at Chen Ji, "Time is running out. Chen Ji, this seat asks you once more—are you willing to 'play a game of chess' with this seat?"

dialogue.content: "This game is not about me replacing the Eye of Heavenly Dao—" Cang Yutian stood with hands clasped behind his back, his tone carrying unprecedented solemnity, "But a game concerning the fate of all worlds across the heavens. This seat will provide you with all the resources and intelligence you need, but the final move must be decided by yourself." His gaze was profound as an abyss, "Of course, you can refuse. In that case, this seat will continue searching for the next candidate—only, if you do, you and your sister will likely not survive the Eye of Heavenly Dao's next cleansing."

text.content: When his sister Chen Nian was mentioned, Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted. Cang Yutian actually knew about Chen Nian? He stared fixedly at those eyes that seemed to see through everything, trying to find flaws. But Cang Yutian's expression was calm as still water, showing no trace of falsehood. At this moment, an unprecedented sense of crisis surged in Chen Ji's heart—he realized his control over the situation was far less than imagined. Cang Yutian's appearance had disrupted all his plans. And more terrifyingly, he couldn't even determine whether the other was friend or foe.

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian used Chen Nian's safety as leverage, demanding cooperation. Facing this possibly greatest choice of a lifetime—

choices.description: Agree for now to stabilize Cang Yutian, secretly gather more information before making judgments. Cang Yutian knows too much; it's unwise to be a direct enemy.
choices.visible_cost: May become Cang Yutian's chess piece
choices.visible_reward: Gain Cang Yutian's resources and intelligence support
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is extremely scheming and easily reversed-controlled

dialogue.content: "Fine." Chen Ji spoke slowly, "I can cooperate with you, Senior. But I have a condition—I want to know everything about my sister. Where she is, what the Heavenly Fate Lock Key means." Cang Yutian nodded slightly: "Straightforward. Your sister is indeed under the control of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key is... a special vessel used to contain overloaded Heavenly Fate power. To save her, you must become far stronger than you are now." He raised his hand, and a jade slip radiating soft light flew toward Chen Ji, "This is the first gift I have prepared for you—a clue regarding the complete version of the Tianji Record."

choices.memory_label: 仓御天与陈机达成初步合作

choices.description: Using Chen Nian's safety to threaten him—this was Chen Ji's逆鳞. Even if the other party was an ultimate chess player, he would not accept such a way of cooperation.
choices.risk_hint: Lose Cang Yutian's intelligence support, but won't be controlled by others

dialogue.content: "Threatening me?" Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold, and those eyes that had always been calm as still water actually erupted with a fierce killing intent, "Cang Yutian, who do you think you are? I've been scheming across the world for so many years—would I bow and scrape because of your几句 threats?" He stepped forward, his aura actually vaguely rivaling Cang Yutian's, "My sister's matter, I will resolve myself. It's your business if you want to find someone to replace the Eye of Heavenly Dao—don't treat me as your替身 from ten thousand years ago!" Cang Yutian looked at this young man and suddenly burst into laughter: "Good! Good indeed, Chen Ji! This seat is increasingly looking forward to your接下来的表现……"

choices.memory_label: 陈机直面仓御天，展现不屈意志

text.content: The Star Sea began to dissipate, and Cang Yutian's figure gradually became illusory. Before vanishing completely, his voice rang out one last time: "Chen Ji, this seat gives you three months to consider. In three months, this seat will come find you again. By then, I hope you can give this seat a satisfactory answer." His tone remained indifferent, but the oppression within it nearly made Chen Ji suffocate, "By the way, one more thing—your红颜知己 Su Qingyao has already sensed your true identity. She is very smart, and also very dangerous. If you don't want her to become your weakness, you'd better find a way to handle her quickly."

Cang Yutian vanished. Chen Ji stood alone, his mind reverberating with the other party's final words. Su Qingyao has already sensed his true identity? This news alarmed him even more than Cang Yutian's recruitment attempt. He had always thought his disguise was flawless, yet he hadn't expected those eyes to have seen through him long ago. Chen Ji clenched his fists, his knuckles whitening from the force. Cang Yutian's appearance had disrupted all his plans, and Su Qingyao's discovery made the situation even worse. He had to make a decision quickly—continue hiding, or take the initiative to confess? Was Cang Yutian's cooperation invitation an opportunity or an abyss? And could that clue about the Eye of Heavenly Dao's weakness become the key for him to defy fate?

Just as Chen Ji fell into deep thought, the turtle shell in his embrace suddenly vibrated violently. He quickly took it out and found the patterns on its inner wall flickering in a strange frequency—that was the Turtle Shell Fragment conveying some kind of message to him. He closed his eyes and probed his consciousness into that chaotic space. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul floated in the void, his features even more blurred than last time, as if he might dissipate at any moment. "Chen Ji." Mo Xiansheng's voice was hoarse and weary, "That person just now... you must be careful. Every word he says, though seemingly helping you, is actually paving the way for his ultimate goal. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's weakness is real, but Cang Yutian himself is by no means benevolent. The truth behind the great war ten thousand years ago is far more complex than what appears on the surface..."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng paused, seemingly hesitating whether to continue. In the end, he still spoke: "Chen Ji, there is something I must tell you—Cang Yutian is not the only challenger to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Before him, three others tried to replace the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but without exception, they all failed. And the reason for their failure... was related to him." A hint of indescribable fear permeated Mo Xiansheng's voice, "Cang Yutian has been scheming for ten thousand years—it is by no means simply for revenge. His ultimate goal may be even more terrifying than replacing the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Cang Yutian, Mo Xiansheng, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... the relationship between these three was far more intricate than he had imagined. He had thought he had grasped enough chess games, but he never expected the true chess players were never in places he could see. The patterns inside the turtle shell gradually calmed, and Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul fell back into slumber. But that phrase "more terrifying than replacing the Eye of Heavenly Dao" coiled around Chen Ji's heart like a venomous snake. He slowly opened his eyes and gazed toward the direction where Cang Yutian had vanished, his eyes flickering with complex light. He had already entered this game. And every step from now on would concern life and death.

Just then, urgent footsteps sounded in the distance. Chen Ji quickly收敛气息 and hid the turtle shell in his embrace. The visitor was a messenger disciple from the Tianqing Sect, rushing toward him with a panicked expression: "Chen Shixiong! It's bad! Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Shimei is looking for you everywhere, saying she has important matters to discuss. Her expression... is very unusual." Chen Ji's heart tightened. Was Su Qingyao looking for him at this time a coincidence, or did she already possess his secret? He took a deep breath, and that harmless,废物 smile reappeared on his face: "Understood, I'll go right away."

Outside the Inner Sect Council Hall of Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji stood before the door, gazing at the tightly closed gate, his heart filled with mixed emotions. Cang Yutian's words still echoed in his ears—Su Qingyao has already sensed his true identity. This woman who had always appeared beside him as an investigator, how much did she know? And why was she looking for him at this moment? Chen Ji took a deep breath, reached out, and pushed open the gate. No matter what, he had to face this hurdle in person. After scheming across the world for so many years, would he really expose flaws before a woman? Even if she was the红颜知己 he had been deliberately avoiding all along.
